name: Digging Through the Ooze
summary: In Menethil Harbor, Sida asks travelers to recover her bag from the ooze that swallowed it. She visits Ironbeard's Tomb regularly, but fled when foul oozes filled the barrows.

sections.title: A Panicked Retreat
sections.body: Sida lives in Menethil Harbor and often travels northeast into the Wetlands to pay homage at Ironbeard's Tomb. On her latest visit, foul, dripping oozes had filled the ancient barrow. She panicked and hurled her satchel at one of them. The ooze swallowed the bag whole, giving Sida just enough time to flee back to the port town. Now she asks travelers to search for it.

sections.title: Sludge of Ironbeard's Tomb
sections.body: Ironbeard's Tomb lies near Dun Modr, the contested stronghold, and holds the remains of a storied dwarven hero. Corruption in the surrounding marshland draws amorphous, acidic slimes that consume anything in their path. Sida cannot remember which creature swallowed her belongings. Travelers must search the tomb grounds and cut through the creeping blight to find her drenched satchel.

faq.answer: Sida is an Alliance traveler who lives in Menethil Harbor. She regularly visits Ironbeard's Tomb in the Wetlands, where oozes recently drove her into danger.
Ironbeard's Tomb lies in the northeastern Wetlands, south of Dun Modr. Corrosive wetland oozes infest the area around the stone barrow.
Sida panicked during the attack and cannot tell the oozes apart. Any of the slimes wandering outside Ironbeard's Tomb may have swallowed her bag.

faq.q: Why was Sida visiting Ironbeard's Tomb?
faq.answer: Sida visits Ironbeard's Tomb each week to pay her respects to the ancient dwarf buried there. Oozes interrupted her peaceful tradition.

faq.q: What happens after the bag is recovered?
faq.answer: When you return the slimy satchel to Menethil Harbor, Sida empties its contents onto the ground to retrieve her belongings. She finds the ruined container too repulsive to keep and offers the cleaned-off bag to whoever recovered it.

faq.q: Is this related to the Dark Iron dwarves nearby?
faq.answer: Dun Modr, just north of the tomb, is caught up in conflict with the Dark Iron clan. The oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb are wild marsh predators native to the Wetlands' damp, rotting corners, not dwarven soldiers.

angles.text: Ironbeard's Tomb holds the remains of an honored dwarven ancestor. For a Bronzebeard loyalist, foul oozes defiling the barrows are an affront.
Menethil Harbor is the Alliance's main lifeline through the treacherous Wetlands. Helping rattled citizens keeps the vital port secure and orderly.
